cards.example_en: They booked a deluxe room with a sea view for the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 他们为假期订了一间看海的豪华房间。

cards.example_en: Young chicks are dependent on the hen for warmth.
cards.example_zh: 小鸡要靠母鸡来取暖。

cards.example_en: He felt depressed after losing the final match by one point.
cards.example_zh: 决赛以一分之差落败后，他感到很沮丧。

cards.example_en: We dine at my uncle's house every Sunday evening.
cards.example_zh: 每个星期日晚上，我们都在叔叔家吃饭。

cards.example_en: Dip the dumpling in vinegar before you take a bite.
cards.example_zh: 咬一口饺子之前，先在醋里蘸一下。

cards.example_en: There is dirt on your shoes, so leave them by the door.
cards.example_zh: 你的鞋上沾着污垢，把它们放在门口吧。

cards.example_en: She stared in disbelief when her name appeared on the screen.
cards.example_zh: 看到自己的名字出现在屏幕上时，她难以置信地盯着看。

cards.example_en: The diver found a lost watch near the rocks by the beach.
cards.example_zh: 潜水员在海滩岩石附近找到了一块丢失的手表。

cards.example_en: That panda documentary starts at eight on Friday evening.
cards.example_zh: 那部熊猫纪录片在星期五晚上八点开始。

cards.example_en: A donkey carried bags of fruit up the narrow mountain path.
cards.example_zh: 一头驴驮着几袋水果走上狭窄的山路。

cards.example_en: The blood donor waited in a quiet room after giving blood.
cards.example_zh: 献血者献完血后在一间安静的房间里等候。

cards.example_en: Put a dot after each short answer on the test paper.
cards.example_zh: 在试卷上每道简短答案后面点一个圆点。

cards.example_en: Let the dough rest for twenty minutes before you roll it.
cards.example_zh: 擀面之前，让面团静置二十分钟。

cards.example_en: Water would not drain from the sink after we washed the rice.
cards.example_zh: 我们淘完米后，水从水槽里排不出去。

cards.example_en: He plays the drum in the school band every Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 他每个星期四在学校乐队里打鼓。

cards.example_en: The grey sky made the whole afternoon feel dull and slow.
cards.example_zh: 灰蒙蒙的天空让整个下午显得又乏味又缓慢。

cards.example_en: That stone dwelling has stood on the hillside for many years.
cards.example_zh: 那座石头住所在山坡上已经立了许多年。

cards.example_en: An eddy spun the fallen leaves in a circle near the bridge.
cards.example_zh: 桥附近，一个漩涡把落叶转成一个圈。

cards.example_en: The new edition of the atlas has a page on melting ice.
cards.example_zh: 这本地图册的新版本有一页讲冰层融化。

cards.example_en: Short, effective notes helped her revise while riding the bus.
cards.example_zh: 简短而有效的笔记帮她在坐公交时复习。

cards.example_en: The waistband is elastic, so these shorts fit after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 裤腰有弹性，所以午饭后这条短裤仍然合身。

cards.example_en: Our class will elect a new monitor on Monday.
cards.example_zh: 我们班星期一将选出新班长。

cards.example_en: The new employee learned the cash register before the lunch rush.
cards.example_zh: 新雇员在午餐高峰前学会了使用收银机。

cards.example_en: Her employer let her start late on the morning of the exam.
cards.example_zh: 考试那天早上，雇主让她晚一点来上班。

cards.example_en: Please enclose a photo when you send the application form.
cards.example_zh: 寄申请表时请附上一张照片。

cards.example_en: I looked up volcanoes in an old encyclopaedia at the library.
cards.example_zh: 我在图书馆一本旧百科全书里查阅了火山。

cards.example_en: The ticket costs twelve euro if you buy it online today.
cards.example_zh: 如果今天在网上购买，这张票要十二欧元。

cards.example_en: The magazine printed an excerpt from her travel diary.
cards.example_zh: 杂志刊登了她旅行日记中的一段摘录。

cards.example_en: Football finals excite the whole neighbourhood every spring.
cards.example_zh: 每年春天，足球决赛都让整个社区兴奋起来。

cards.example_en: The puzzled expression on his face showed he had missed the joke.
cards.example_zh: 他脸上困惑的表情说明他没听懂那个笑话。

cards.example_en: The dentist had to extract a tooth that had been hurting.
cards.example_zh: 牙医不得不拔掉那颗一直作痛的牙。

cards.example_en: She raised one eyebrow when I told her the strange story.
cards.example_zh: 我讲起那个奇怪的故事时，她扬起了一边眉毛。

cards.example_en: A faint smell of bread came from the bakery down the street.
cards.example_zh: 街那头的面包店飘来一股淡淡的面包味。

cards.example_en: That watch looks expensive, but the logo is fake.
cards.example_zh: 那块表看起来很贵，但上面的标志是假的。

cards.example_en: Dinosaurs fascinate my little brother more than any cartoon.
cards.example_zh: 恐龙比任何动画片都更让我弟弟着迷。

cards.example_en: The family prepared a feast for Grandpa's seventieth birthday.
cards.example_zh: 家人为爷爷的七十岁生日准备了一桌盛宴。

cards.example_en: A white feather drifted down from the bird above the roof.
cards.example_zh: 一根白羽毛从屋顶上方的鸟儿身上飘了下来。

cards.example_en: We took the ferry across the river to reach the old town.
cards.example_zh: 我们乘渡船过河，去到那座古城。

cards.example_en: Sherlock Holmes is a fictional detective in those London stories.
cards.example_zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯是那些伦敦故事里的虚构侦探。

cards.example_en: Nobody dared to pass the fierce dog outside the warehouse.
cards.example_zh: 没有人敢从仓库外面那条凶猛的狗身边经过。

cards.example_en: The shark's fin cut through the water near the boat.
cards.example_zh: 鲨鱼的鳍在船附近划开了水面。

cards.example_en: Paper boats float down the stream after the summer rain.
cards.example_zh: 夏雨过后，纸船顺着小溪漂下去。

cards.example_en: It was foolish to leave my phone on the bus seat.
cards.example_zh: 把手机落在公交车座位上太愚蠢了。

cards.example_en: A muddy footprint marked the clean floor near the door.
cards.example_zh: 门边干净的地板上留着一个泥脚印。

cards.example_en: Phones are forbidden in the exam room from start to finish.
cards.example_zh: 从开始到结束，考场里都禁止使用手机。

cards.example_en: The parade moved forth down the main street after the drums started.
cards.example_zh: 鼓声响起后，游行队伍沿着大街向前走。

cards.example_en: We were fortunate to find seats on the crowded holiday train.
cards.example_zh: 我们很幸运，在拥挤的假日火车上找到了座位。

cards.example_en: One half is a fraction, and we use it to share a pizza.
cards.example_zh: 二分之一是一个分数，我们用它来分食一块披萨。

cards.example_en: The wooden frame around the class photo came loose.
cards.example_zh: 班级合影周围的木框松了。

cards.example_en: Loud thunder can frighten our dog at night.
cards.example_zh: 夜里的响雷会把我们的狗吓到。

word.example_en: The town is dependent on the river.
word.example_zh: 这座小镇依赖于这条河。
